target.title: fix(agents): handle stdout/stderr stream errors in find tool
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `find` tool spawns `fd`/`find` and reads stdout/stderr through a `readline` interface. If either stream emits an error before or during line processing, the error is not handled, which can crash the agent process with an unhandled exception. The child process may also be left running after the error.

## Why This Change Was Made

Mirror the fix already applied to `bash` (#101005) and `grep` (#101014): attach explicit error handlers to both the readline interface and the raw stdout/stderr streams. On a stream error the child is now terminated before the tool rejects, so transient stream failures are logged, the tool result reflects the failure, and no orphan `fd` process remains.

## User Impact

Agent runs using the `find` tool are more resilient to OS-level stream failures (e.g., pipe errors, resource limits).

## Evidence

- Updated regression tests in `src/agents/sessions/tools/find.fd.test.ts` to assert that the child is killed when stdout or stderr emits an error.
- Added a real behavior proof script at `scripts/proof/find-tool-stream-errors.mts` that places a fake `fd` on PATH, forces stdout/stderr stream errors, and verifies the tool rejects cleanly and the child is killed.

Local verification:

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/sessions/tools/find.fd.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  5 passed (5)

$ OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/agents/sessions/tools/find.ts src/agents/sessions/tools/find.fd.test.ts scripts/proof/find-tool-stream-errors.mts
Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.

$ node --import tsx scripts/proof/find-tool-stream-errors.mts
=== Proof: find tool stream error catch ===

Rejected as expected: fd stdout error: stdout read failed

PASS: find tool caught stream errors and killed the child process.
```
